note: Schema documents describe the authoring contract. They are documentation: the loader skips content/schemas/ and they do not affect the catalog hash.

units.power: integer power-unit milli-units; power is never a stored commodity
units.no_floating_point: the loader rejects fractional and exponent literals outright

identifiers: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore; 1..64 characters

facilities[].category: one of agriculture, mining, industry, energy, logistics, services, administration
facilities[].recipes[]: 1 or 2 fixed variants; an instance's variant cannot change after it is created
facilities[].min_build_days: at least 1; the resolver also enforces the global construction minimum
facilities[].maintenance_machinery_per_day: milli machinery per day, paid even when idle

passive.power_output: power milli, unscaled by staffing or condition

facilities[].buildable: defaults true; a one-per-world founding asset must set this false

recipe.id: required and unique across the whole catalog
recipe.staff: full-staff worker count; a zero-staff recipe may not produce commodities
recipe.power_per_day: operating power demand at full throughput
recipe.inputs: resource map consumed per day at full throughput
recipe.outputs: resource map produced per day at full throughput
recipe.efficiency_class: none, agriculture or mining; a world modifier scales outputs only
recipe.priority_band: ascending resolution order; ties break on instance id
recipe.power_output_per_day: generator supply; a generator may not also consume operating power
recipe.cargo_handling_per_day: milli cargo-volume handled at full service
